source: 환상의동물과 일반동물들을교감시켜 나의 반려동물로만드는 게임환상의동물은 드래곤 유니콘 불사조 구미호 히드라 그리핀 와이번 백호가있고 일반동물은햄스터 여우 늑대 판다 기린 고양이 코뿔소 앵무새 순록 고릴라 등이있고 해양생물은 돌고래 범고래 물개 상어 가오리 해파리 바다거북이 등이있고 정글에사는동물은 도마뱀 이구아나 카멜레온 플라밍고 맵은 판타지,정글,정원,초원,바다가있고 정원에는곤충이살아 곤충은 잠자리,사슴벌레,메뚜기,여치,하늘소,개미,대벌레 등이 있어 일반동물을 잡으려면 사과를줘야되고 곤충은 잡으려면사과2개가필요함 사슴벌레를잡으려면 사과5개필요하고 판타지동물들을잡으려면 환상의과일을얻어야하는데 판타지세계로 가서 환상나무가있는데 환상나무에서2분에 3개씩 환상의과일이나오는데 환상의과일을 받으면 15개로 환상의동물을잡고 상점이있는데거기서 사과를파는데 사과1개당3원이고 먹이물고기3원이다 해양생물은물고기를6개주면반려동물로만들수있어

image_prompt.text: A shop stall players keep returning to, selling apples and fish bait
Walkable routes linking the garden, grassland, jungle, ocean shore and fantasy zones
The fantasy tree — a distinct tree visible across the fantasy zone that magic fruit grows on
five separate natural zones — fantasy, jungle, garden, grassland and ocean — flowing into one another

wild animals populating each zone: dragons, unicorns, phoenixes, gumiho, hydras, griffins, wyverns and white tigers in the fantasy zone; hamsters, foxes, wolves, pandas, giraffes, cats, rhinos, parrots, reindeer and gorillas on the grassland; lizards, iguanas, chameleons and flamingos in the jungle; dragonflies, stag beetles, grasshoppers, katydids, longhorn beetles, ants and stick insects in the garden; dolphins, orcas, seals, sharks, rays, jellyfish and sea turtles in the ocean
an ocean zone with water the marine animals live in
apple trees in the garden and grassland to gather apples from

layout_placement.text: Apples, fish and magic fruit — the items every capture is paid for with, gathered from trees and water across the zones

notes: No preset was taken: Pet Care assumes a claimable-house town and Animal Sim assumes the player is the animal, and neither describes catching wild creatures to keep.
If the fantasy world is a separate place rather than part of one contiguous map, this becomes P4.
The ocean zone may need underwater play volume handling that no option here covers.
The prompt's capture costs, prices and spawn rate are load-bearing numbers with no field to carry them.

open_questions.ask: Should the whole map read as bright and cartoony, or should the fantasy zone be high-fantasy against realistic biomes?
Is the fantasy world reached from the same map, or is it a separate place you travel to?

coverage_missing.ask: What visual style — cute and stylized, or realistic animals?
Is the fantasy world a separate map or part of the same one?
How big is each zone — a walkable garden, or a full biome?
Is the goal to collect every species, or is there something else to do with the pets?

answers.ask: Should the whole map read as bright and cartoony, or should the fantasy zone be high-fantasy against realistic biomes?
answers.answer: 전체 맵은 밝고 귀여운 카툰 스타일로 만들어 주세요. 판타지 구역도 같은 스타일 안에서 신비롭게 표현하면 됩니다.

answers.ask: Is the fantasy world reached from the same map, or is it a separate place you travel to?
answers.answer: 판타지 세계는 같은 맵 안에서 이동할 수 있는 별도의 판타지 구역으로 해주세요. 그곳에 환상나무를 배치합니다.
